gross_amount_at_minimum.meaning: the campaign creator supplies a gross amount exactly at the minimum per hour, so the gross amount passes the rewardTokenMinAmounts validation

nonzero_fees_apply.meaning: non-zero protocol fees apply to the campaign amount

net_amount_below_floor.meaning: the stored and distributed net amount per epoch falls below the guardian-configured rewardTokenMinAmounts floor
net_amount_below_floor.checkpoint: after fee subtraction, at storage/distribution of newCampaign.amount

policy_lever_weakened.meaning: the protocol's policy lever of no campaign below X per epoch is weakened: non-zero fees silently push actual emissions below the configured threshold whenever creators choose the minimum valid gross amount
policy_lever_weakened.checkpoint: after campaign creation with minimum valid gross amount

assumptions: The scenario is conditional: it applies whenever creators choose the minimum valid gross amount; no real transaction is asserted.
Campaign creator is the actor submitting campaign creation to the DistributionCreator contract.
The minimum floor is the guardian-configured rewardTokenMinAmounts per-epoch threshold.

unresolved.description: Exact fee value and resulting net amount are not quantified, so the numeric relation between gross amount, fees, and the per-epoch floor cannot be expressed as an arithmetic comparison; the below-floor condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The below-floor relation is encoded as a report-grounded Boolean because the report supplies no numeric fee or net amount.
The claim formalizes only v_policy_lever_weakened; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
Runtime binding of the Boolean observables to contract code is deferred.
